_comment: Example only. No real credentials here. Copy to reports-policy.json outside Git and point state_dir/config_path at it.
_state_dir: Durable dispatch state (claims + quota ledger). Outside Git, 0700, on the VPS. Never in the vault.

repos._comment: kind=wiki turns on the vault tier table (mathai-wiki/CLAUDE.md § Tiers): T1 compiled pages need the owner, an edit to an existing fontes/ file is T0, a deletion is T0, navigation and working notes auto-merge on green lint.

tau_intent._comment: The two-week hold runs from the day the OWNER activated the manual cycle, not from when a PR was opened. Leave activated_on null until that day is decided: a null blocks every tau-intent merge, which is the intended default.

quota._estimated_daily_budget_pct: Used ONLY for a provider whose probe reports no long window at all. There is no default: leave a provider out of this map and the dispatcher raises UnknownQuota instead of inventing a budget. Each entry must name who declared the number.
quota._accounts: Ledger key. Two CLIs on one subscription must share one account string, or each will spend a full daily budget (F0 §2.1: Claude Code, claude.ai and Desktop share a limit).
quota._five_hour_reset_policy: Default false: an expired resets_at means the snapshot is stale, not that the window refilled. Setting this true requires declared_by and still asks for a re-probe.

routing._models: Only `agent --list-models` exists on the installed CLIs (2026-09-14). claude and codex are launched without --model, tabled as `default`.

handoff._comment: argv receives JSON on stdin {provider, model, task_id, prompt}. Omit command to record handoffs without launching a subprocess.

digest._external_comments: false = a T0 suggestion is recorded as a local receipt for the ledger and nothing is posted to GitHub. Only the owner flips this.
